text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Duramente reported to her clan's 
associates that she would not be 
challenging the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe 
this year either.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
When she expressed that she had let down 
their expectations, her family members 
told her they supported her choice, 
praising her determination to shoulder 
everything herself.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Filled with everyone's warm support, 
Duramente vows anew to bear the mantle of 
the "strongest."

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
In the Takarazuka Kinen, standing in 
Duramente's way were her very own 
classmates.
